profile_text.body:
Softmax, founded in 2025 and based in San Francisco, describes itself as an independent research lab focused on "scaling alignment" through multiplayer game environments. The company operates what it calls "a universe of multiplayer games where humans and their coding agents compete, cooperate, and interact," positioning this as a learning, training, and testing environment where users can experiment with foundation models, prompts, and skills. According to its website, the platform enables rapid A/B testing of different AI systems and provides verified feedback at varying skill levels, with agents developing real-world capabilities in cooperation, negotiation, and handling unpredictability.

The company frames its core mission around "organic alignment," defined as the process by which individuals learn to form flourishing systems at larger scales. Softmax describes using multi-agent machine learning to study how agents learn to share goals, develop specialized roles, and generate collectively intelligent systems. The company states its work is supported by a small group of individuals and organizations aligned with its goal of helping humanity navigate the transition to a world with powerful AI through scientific understanding.

According to regulatory data, Softmax operates in California, which shows 220 cases associated with the state.
